description: Header file providing support for creating and managing Python subinterpreters using pybind11, including classes for subinterpreter management and scope-based activation.

classes.name: subinterpreter
classes.description: Represents a Python subinterpreter, allowing creation, management, and destruction of interpreters.

classes.name: subinterpreter_scoped_activate
classes.description: Manages scope-based activation and GIL handling for a subinterpreter.

classes.name: scoped_subinterpreter
classes.description: RAII wrapper that creates a subinterpreter and activates it within a scope.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new subinterpreter with specified or default configuration.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Returns a handle to the main interpreter.

methods.name: current
methods.description: Returns a non-owning wrapper of the currently active interpreter.

methods.name: id
methods.description: Returns the numerical identifier of the subinterpreter.

methods.name: disarm
methods.description: Disarms the interpreter handle to prevent cleanup (leak).

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the interpreter wrapper is empty.

methods.name: operator bool
methods.description: Checks if the interpreter wrapper is non-empty.
